title: IndiaMART B2B Supplier Scraper Input
description: Scrape supplier/product records from public IndiaMART category pages.

keywords.title: Category Keywords
keywords.description: IndiaMART category keywords. The actor converts each keyword to a category URL, for example cotton fabric -> /impcat/cotton-fabric.html.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city filter, for example Mumbai or Jaipur. Leave empty for all-India category pages.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum clean supplier records to save across all keywords.

includeOrganic.title: Include Organic Cards
includeOrganic.description: Extract visible organic supplier/product cards from the category page.

includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Data
includeSponsored.description: Extract sponsored/all-India records from embedded page data when available.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential India proxy is recommended for stable access to IndiaMART category pages.
